resolved_boundaries: Root Maven coordinates sc.fiji:Colocalisation_Analysis:3.1.0 and official release tag resolve to the manifest build commit; root POM, plugins.config and Groovy template match the official source bytes.

Root POM inherits org.scijava:pom-scijava:38.0.1 then pom-scijava-base:19.0.0. Its managed direct dependency versions match the historical JAR Class-Path, not the newer bundled runtime versions. Both are retained separately.

Six non-test direct dependencies are fiji-lib,ij,imglib2,imglib2-algorithm,imglib2-ij,itextpdf. JUnit is test-only. Optional/provided/test/system and conditional profile edges remain visible and are not silently treated as mandatory shipped code.

Metadata-free Jama/Trove/Caffeine/EJML aliases have exact Maven Central binary equality evidence; inherited group/property/managed-version resolution and actual pinned component targets are retained in the resolved graph.
The three plugins.config commands are distinct descriptors, not aliases proving one another complete. No descriptor runtime or workflow acceptance follows from this license handoff.

Root binary contains no embedded model weights, fonts or image/data fixtures. Its only application resource beyond metadata/registration is the1304-byte Groovy example; source-test image fixtures are not shipped in this root JAR.

unresolved_items.detail: The actual bundled dependency is5.5.13.4, while the root build requested5.5.13.3. Exact embedded AGPL/license/NOTICE and26 resources are inventoried, including14 Adobe AFM metrics,mustRead.html,glyphlist.txt and additional code notices. Match the5.5.13.4 source release and each separate grant/notice to these bytes before dependency eligibility or an incorporation route is approved. A GPL/AGPL label alone is insufficient.

Coloc code declares GPL-3.0-or-later; iText declares AGPLv3 with additional legal-notice/PDF-producer retention language. Review the intended copied/linked versus independently authored native implementation and exact redistribution/source/network obligations. No commercial iText agreement was supplied, and no closed-source exception is assumed. Copyleft is not a non-commercial exclusion.

The36-node default graph resolves component identities but does not complete every source/grant/resource decision. Preserve its exact reusable hashes and edges; next review concrete leaves rather than regenerate the graph. SLF4J has an embedded MIT notice despite no child-POM license declaration; UDUNITS4.3.18 lacks an embedded license notice and needs its exact upstream/inherited grant/source binding. POM declarations and inherited metadata are evidence, not blanket component acceptance.

The exact source template matches the shipped bytes and the project declares GPLv3+. The POM excludes script_templates from license-header processing; this is not evidence of an NC restriction or an alternative license. Record the applicable project/resource grant and notice handling explicitly before resource clearance; do not infer unlicensed merely from the missing header.

The default declared graph is not a JVM loader trace. Parent Kotlin profile activation depends on src/main/kotlin; the root release has no such source and selected class bytes have no kotlin/ reference, but no arbitrary profile/runtime activation is certified. Groovy execution of the optional example requires the provided scripting environment, whose incorporation is not approved by reviewing the template. No full Fiji/JDK/platform clearance is claimed.

observed_license_and_resource_evidence.remaining: Corresponding-source/license/notice obligations must be consumed if code is incorporated; root license identification is not full dependency closure.

observed_license_and_resource_evidence.identified_terms: AGPLv3, additional notice requirements and retention of iText producer line for PDFs; commercial-license alternative is separate and not assumed.

Multiple third-party code notices include Unicode,Adobe XMP,Apache,TIFF and other attribution/permission statements. Exact source/grant compatibility review remains open; this report does not collapse them into AGPL alone.

Adobe AFM metrics permission permits use/copy/distribution for any purpose with copyright/readme retention and modification-notice conditions. These are metrics, not a general grant for arbitrary fonts.
observed_license_and_resource_evidence.remaining: Preserve exact14 AFM/readme association and attribution if incorporated; do not extend this permission to glyphlist or other assets without evidence.

observed_license_and_resource_evidence.identified_terms: Embedded MIT permission/notice identified; broader version/source and material review remains separately recorded.
